acceptance: The PR quotes both conflicting texts with file paths and names which is authoritative, decided by the owner.
Code, ADR, methodology page and MCP instructions agree afterwards; a test pins the TPC-DS subscale classification.
The change goes through the external soundness review if it touches ranking or compliance code.
context: Source: found on 2026-11-13 while delivering the agent-facing work (PRs BenchBox-dev/benchbox#4202, #4203 and BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site#152, #153, #154). Reported in the body of site PR #153; the exact location of the core contract was not recorded there and must be found first. Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone. Related items share one feature branch and PR where their files overlap. No live-cloud runs and no credentials in Git or logs; heavy work only through lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status. Follow the comment policy and add a changelog.d fragment for user-facing changes. Re-verify every cited file and line before acting; they are hints. Stop and report rather than widen scope.
description:
Problem: the methodology review found that core's TPC-DS subscale contract and the ADR 'Rank Subscale TPC-H and TPC-DS Results as Unofficial' disagree on how subscale TPC-DS results are treated. benchbox/core/results/subscale_policy.py excludes only non-standard runs from ranking. The MCP instructions now say subscale results 'remain ranked, but never as official results'; if the TPC-DS contract differs, that sentence and the methodology page may be wrong for TPC-DS.

Outcome: one rule, stated in the ADR and enforced by code, with the methodology page and MCP text matching it.
